observations.mechanism: Raw-byte hashes changed when Git converted LF governance artifacts to CRLF on Windows.
Reflection adapters imported tools.reflection_core while documented direct script execution places tools/ rather than the repository root on sys.path.
A reusable DevOS port can retain source-project vocabulary in executable contracts unless installation validation checks it explicitly.

changes: Canonicalize governance text to LF before hashing.

Validate configured source-project terms outside explicit provenance files.
